### *A Book About Calabria, Italy*

ONCE THE HUB OF THE MEDITERRANEAN, Calabria now dangles, largely ignored, at the bottom of the
Italian boot, struggling for survival, acceptance and a place in modern Italy and the world.
Little-known even to Italians outside the nefarious activities of its ‘Ndrangheta mafia
organization, Calabria allures with its simplicity and rewards with an underlying complexity, as in
the savoring of an artisanal cheese, appreciating an ancient Greek masterwork or interpreting a
particularly expressive phrase in the local dialect.

Based on the author’s experiences, living, working and traveling throughout the region, as well as
on extensive research, *Calabria: The Other Italy* paints a compelling picture of contemporary
Calabria. The book intertwines observation, personal anecdote, salient historical information and
social commentary into a nonfiction narrative that combines travelogue with an exploration of
everyday life and culture. At times humorous, at others poignant, this fascinating work shares the
joys and challenges of the “other Italy.”

### *A Book About Calabria, Italy*

ONCE THE HUB OF THE MEDITERRANEAN, Calabria now dangles, largely ignored, at the bottom of the
Italian boot, struggling for survival, acceptance and a place in modern Italy and the world.
Little-known even to Italians outside the nefarious activities of its ‘Ndrangheta mafia
organization, Calabria allures with its simplicity and rewards with an underlying complexity, as in
the savoring of an artisanal cheese, appreciating an ancient Greek masterwork or interpreting a
particularly expressive phrase in the local dialect.

Based on the author’s experiences, living, working and traveling throughout the region, as well as
on extensive research, *Calabria: The Other Italy* paints a compelling picture of contemporary
Calabria. The book intertwines observation, personal anecdote, salient historical information and
social commentary into a nonfiction narrative that combines travelogue with an exploration of
everyday life and culture. At times humorous, at others poignant, this fascinating work shares the
joys and challenges of the “other Italy.”

From colorful tales of encounters with the *Calabrese* people to those of a windsurfing saint, from
the unparalleled pair of 2,500-year-old Riace Bronzes to a couple of dancing giants, from ancient
castles and towers to pristine beaches and mountains, from the unique bergamot fruit to an
exceptional culinary tradition, *Calabria: The Other Italy* embraces daily life, culture, history,
the arts, food, society and tourism of this beautiful, southern Italian region. Excursions to Sicily
and Basilicata are also included!

# Mobility.

*Portugal’s Prime Minister Luís Montenegro shakes hands with Empowered Startups’ President Chris
Lennon.*

We build and administer the future of innovation-led immigration and economic development for
governments and universities by attracting global talent to new jurisdictions, driving FDI (foreign
direct investment) in applied research, building innovation clusters, and enabling high human
capital to migrate with purpose.

Venture Forward.

## We Support and Work With

Business Professionals & Academics

### Global mobility for talented professionals

Empowered Startups helps highly qualified professionals, entrepreneurs, innovators, and academics
relocate their ideas, expertise, and families through Startup, Innovation, and HQA Visas. We guide
you from application to arrival, supporting your move to new countries and markets so you can launch
and grow ventures in dynamic innovation ecosystems.

commercialize innovations and bring novel discoveries to market. We help design and deliver programs
that attract high‑human capital and foreign direct investment, accelerating the journey from lab to
marketplace while building innovation clusters and stimulating local economies.

## Natural Food Colors

100% plant-based, vibrant, odor free natural food colors. We gently obtain our natural products from
our own plant sources, where we control the planting, care and harvesting before any processing
takes place.

Our processing typically uses gentle physical processes such as squeezing, rinsing, filtering and
concentrating. Sometimes we take advantage of natural processes within the plant to obtain the raw
materials we use to make our finished products.

## All Natural Sweeteners

A global supplier of sustainable natural sweeteners. FoodRGB^{®} is a natural sweetener
manufacturer, direct sale, and solution provider. We are best in Allulose, Monk Fruit Extract V50,
and Stevia RA98, RA80.

We do natural sweeteners wholesale from coast to coast. We also set up warehouses globally, so we
become sustainable natural sweetener supplier. We are natural sweetener distributors in the USA.
Natural sweetener is complex to use and the quality depends on many factors and varies a lot.

## A Variety of Food and Beverage Applications

We understand the nature of these products and their natural sensitivities associated with natural
food color and natural sweetener systems. As a custom supplier of natural food color ingredients and
sweetening solutions, we continuously refine and optimize our formulations to meet the evolving
performance, stability, and labeling requirements of modern food and beverage applications.

Our research and application teams leverage deep technical expertise in natural food color
stability, pH performance, heat resistance, and processing compatibility to ensure reliable results.
From straightforward formulations to complex manufacturing environments, we develop customized
ingredient solutions designed to perform consistently across diverse food and beverage systems.

## Sertifikalarımız

## 01 Kaynağında Başlayan Kalite

- En iyi ürün, en kaliteli ham maddeyle başlar.

Grup şirketimiz Asuka, dünyanın dört bir yanından etkinliği kanıtlanmış, saf ve farmasötik
kalitedeki hammaddeyi/bileşenleri tedarik eder.

Her gelen ham madde, kendi laboratuvarlarımızda detaylı analizlerden geçerek kalite standartlarımıza
uygunluğu doğrulanır.

Her ham madde, tesisimize ulaştığında; etkin madde oranı, mikrobiyolojik saflık, fiziksel
özellikler, ağır metal ve pestisit kalıntıları ile ilgili kapsamlı testlerden geçirilir. Stabilite
ve raf ömrü ön testleri de uygulanarak uzun vadeli güvenlik ve etkinlik doğrulanır.

-    🧬 Yüksek Saflık | 🌍 Güvenilir Tedarik | 🔬 Kendi Laboratuvarlarımızda Kontrol

## 02 Gelişmiş Teknoloji ile Üretim

- Her kapsülde bilim ve kalite var.

Üretim sürecimiz, bize ait fabrikamızda; farmasötik düzeyde hassasiyet sunan yüksek teknolojili
makinelerle gerçekleştirilir.

🔹 Likit kapsül teknolojisi, lipozomal yapı, CO₂ ekstraksiyonu ile birlikte kromatografi yöntemleri
kullanılarak;

      • Doğal bileşenler saf ve etkili şekilde elde edilir.

      • Ekstraktlardaki aktif madde oranı en üst seviyeye çıkarılır.

      •Aktif bileşenlerin biyoyararlanımı artırılır.

⚙️ GMP uyumlu üretim | 🧠 Biyoyararlanım odaklı formülasyon

## 03 Güvenilir Ürün, Hazır Form

- Tüketicilerimize ulaşan her ürün, bizim imzamızı taşır.

Üretilen her ürün; etkinlik, güvenlik ve stabilite testlerinden geçirilerek şeffaf, kaliteli ve
katkısız içeriklerle kullanıma hazır hale getirilir.

📦 Goodday markalı ürünlerimiz, kapsül, tablet, saşe ve sıvı formda tüketiciyle buluşur.

🔍 Sertifikalı kalite | 🛡 Glutensiz ve güvenli içerik | 🇹🇷 Türkiye’de üretilmiştir

## About Horner

##### Horner International is rooted in generations of ancestors who tilled the soil and lived
##### according to the values and traditions of rural North Carolina farming communities. My
##### grandfather was a sharecropper and when my father left the farm for college, there was no
##### money to give him, but he became steward of several acres of farmland, on which he planted,
##### tended, harvested and sold the crops to pay his way through school.  My grandmother tended a
##### garden into her eighties; little did she know that her ways might be described by the
##### buzzwords of our day: artisanal, organic, locavore, hand-crafted.  Proust had his madeleine;
##### for me, the aromas of childhood are just-shucked corn, my mother’s cobbler from freshly-picked
##### blueberries, and the incomparable fresh butter bean, which reaches perfection during perhaps a
##### fortnight in the hot North Carolina summer.   Real food, as close to nature as possible, is in
##### our blood.

##### Horner International’s first product in 1995 was a cocoa extract.   We still manufacture it
##### today, and it has been sold continuously on every continent since those early days.  Over the
##### years we have expanded our production capabilities and are constantly in search of new
##### botanicals and production methods.  Like most of the best in life, much of what we do comes
##### from ancient things, like extraction and distillation, but the devil, as the saying goes, is
##### in the details.  Discovering a new plant or developing a new way to extract its flavor thrills
##### and excites us, and is at the heart of what we do.

##### Horner’s second factory, built in 2007, stands in a vanishingly rural part of Durham, North
##### Carolina, and our neighbors include herds of deer, flocks of wild turkeys and a farmer who
##### sells collard greens from his porch.   Down the road is the renowned Research Triangle Park
##### and world-famous universities like UNC-Chapel Hill and North Carolina State, with whom we have
##### collaborated on research projects for over twenty years. Inside our plant is some of the
##### finest and most advanced equipment in the world to extract and perfect natural flavors.  We
##### are constantly investing in new equipment and many of the largest flavor houses and consumer
##### products companies in the world trust us to manufacture extracts and flavors under their
##### names.  As much as we take a “gearhead” pride in our machines, it is people who make the
##### difference at Horner.  It takes a special person to work at a smaller company, for every day
##### is punctuated by what we optimistically call challenges.  The result is that an exceedingly
##### diverse group of strong minds and strong hands crank out the finest natural extracts in the
##### world. Creativity, dedication and pride go into every pail, drum and tote that heads to
##### customers across the globe.  Are you ready for the Alternative to Artificial? Connect  with us
##### and let us show you how.

Panel 2

## The Ethics of Extracts

##### WORKING WITH ALL-NATURAL GOODS MEANS THAT WE CULTIVATE CLOSE RELATIONSHIPs WITH THE
##### INDIVIDUALS AND FARMS THAT SUPPLY OUR RAW MATERIALS. From the blooming desert of xinjiang to
##### our own farm in Bailey, North Carolina, we have two decades of on-the-ground experience with
##### the farmers and soils that produce our raw materials.  Our business cannot exist without
##### sustainable agriculture, and the bumper stickers sometimes seen on North Carolina pickup
##### trucks say it best, “No  farmers, no food.”

# Les Breuvages du Voironnais (LBDV) : 125 ans de savoir-faire en boissons naturelles

## Chez LBDV nous défendons des goûts exceptionnels qui font partie de notre identité

Experts français de l’extraction végétale et de l’assemblage aromatique depuis 1898, nous voyons LES
GOÛTS comme DES PATRIMOINES VIVANTS : naturels, authentiques, historiques et iconiques. 
‍

**Notre vocation est de faire (RE)VIVRE ces goûts francs et sincères, **préserver leurs
savoir-faire, faire parler leurs arômes de fleurs, de plantes ou de fruits en les combinant à
l’infini remettre au goût du jour ces saveurs d’un autre temps, être les garants de leur qualité et
de leur pérennité. 
‍

**Parce que ces goûts exceptionnels font parti de notre identité, chez LBDV nous les défendons parce
qu’ils nous ouvrent tout un nouveau monde de boissons. **

**
CAR LE GOÛT EST UN SURSAUT. UNE SUR****PRIS****E.

**

NOUS CREONS DES BOISSONS POUR MARQUER LES ESPRITS.

assembler, ce n’est pas juste pour le plaisir de les mettre en bouteille, mais pour servir à tous
les français...

savoir-faire centenaire, l'entreprise maîtrise l'art de combiner et d'extraire les essences
végétales, offrant des boissons aux arômes complexes et équilibrés. Cette expertise garantit des
produits de caractère, capables de satisfaire les palais les plus exigeants.

colorants, sans sucres ajoutés.  Antésite propose également toute une gamme de boissons
rafraîchissantes et savoureuses à base d’extraits de plantes ou de fruits, pour accompagner tous vos
instants de vie !

# UNIQUE STRENGTHS

Our up-to-dated R&D center has enabled Réglisse Innovations to develop solutions for our
customers.It gives Clients the luxury of having their own Pilot scale and industrial scale
production facility.

[Quick Delivery]

## QUICK DELIVERY

Réglisse Innovations sales office in Europe is backed by its product inventory in Rotterdam which
results in swift delivery, and its own extraction facility in Georgia maintains an extensive
inventory of remarkable quantity of products in stock.

[Georgian Origin]

### GEORGIAN ORIGIN (DUTY FREE)

Réglisse Innovations is supplying to you from the most safe origin among all other suppliers with no
political issues and at a very reachable location, with our certificate of origin you can import our
products directly from factory on Duty Free basis or we will supply you from our already imported
goods within EU quickly with a certificate of origin issues under Georgia Republic. Georgia is the
most regulated country of origins among all other licorice extract suppliers.
[Exclusive Raw Material Access]

### Exclusive Raw Material Access

Réglisse Innovations has an exclusive access to the richest Glycyrrhiza Glabra resources in Caucasus
region via [Licorice LLC][7] our subsidiary in Armenia, selecting and collecting from all countries
in Caucasus area.

# know-how

#### “We have self-developed extraction techniques and equipment!”


We have a great team over here in Réglisse Innovations, Our professional sales and marketing team in
Europe extract the required information from our customers to clearly find out what are their needs,
the obtained info firstly will be checked with our inventory in Europe for swift delivery in case of
need then will be transferred to: [INNOVO Extraction Technologies Inc.( INNOVOETI)][8] our R&D
center in Canada as well as our Quality Assurance team in our extraction facility in Georgia [Georeg
LLC-Licorice Processing ][9]to set up the production as per requirements, our precise and effective
OTD system assures a smooth delivery to our customers

Our team has been through a constant development, mass production, safe and consistent Licorice root
collection, QC tests for many years and we have all required skills in our arsenal!

Hence, we produce licorice extracts in all main forms: powder, block, liquid, semi fluid. And
Licorice Root Sticks with “THE BEST QUALITY IN THE WORLD”. All of our products are available in
stock inside Europe at certain quantities

according to the FSSC 22000 standard, will be granted both certifications within 2019.

to ensure supplying a constant quality at highest level.

Réglisse Innovations provides a complete technical file for each batch of products based on our
internal traceability system as well as standard’s requirements.

Our R&D Center [INNOVO Extraction Technologies Inc.( INNOVOETI)][12]  together with flexible
extraction facility as well as our innovative team enables , that have been leading, of having a
protection shield against the supply and sales market fluctuation.







# CONSISTENCY:

“No consistency, no success”

The constant flow of Licorice Root supply at high quality via [Licorice LLC][13] to our production
facility at [Georeg Licorice Processing][14] maintaining our Root inventory at extraction units
enabled us to keep our consistency on production and our products specification.

We keep contently a quantity of 6 month full capacity production at site and keep maintaining it on
an extreme discipline.

“Our commitment is to provide full support”

our in stock products, **immediate product change policy** as well as a direct contact to work
closely with our production line and R&D center is offering a very rare convenience to our
customers. This way, together with **you** a lot of opportunities are ahead to bring new and
innovative products in the market. Our production facility is always open for you to visit even at
short notice, located at very convenient and **safe** location 3 hours away in average from Europe
with direct flights to Tbilisi departing from many capital cities within EU and rest of Europe.

**Plant extraction production line**
 
The plant extraction production line is the core industrial system for modern natural product
processing. Fundamentally, it is a comprehensive process that uses physical or chemical methods to
efficiently separate and purify active ingredients (such as essential oils, polysaccharides,
polyphenols, and proteins) from plant matrices, converting them into high-value-added products.
[ [Plant extraction production line] ][21]
**Vacuum Belt Dryer**
 
Vacuum Belt Dryer (BVD) is a low-temperature drying method that involves continuously distributing
raw materials onto a conveyor belt under vacuum conditions. The materials are dried as the belt
moves over heating plates, followed by cooling, embrittlement, and pulverization. Throughout the
entire drying process, the extract remains in a vacuum-sealed environment, and the mild drying
conditions (operating temperature: 30–135°C) help preserve its properties to the greatest extent,
resulting in a high-quality final product.
[ [vacuum belt dryer] ][22]
**Multistage Plug Flow Countercurrent Extraction Reactor Unit**
 
The PFR countercurrent extraction unit is a continuous, highly efficient natural product extraction
equipment designed based on the principles of the Plug Flow Reactor (PFR). It is widely used in the
pharmaceutical, food, health supplement, and chemical industries.
 
[ [Multistage Plug Flow Countercurrent Extraction Reactor Unit Machine Equipment ] ][23]
**Aroma Recovery System**
 
Senbo Fluid has developed an innovative system that helps to capture and preserve key aroma
compounds that are otherwise commonly lost during coffee processing.
[ [Spinning Cone Column Aroma Recovery System Machine Equipment ] ][24]

# Manufacturer of World Class 100% Pure & Natural Essential Oils, Resins, Perfume Oils and Fragrance
# Oils

Since our inception in the year 1990, the primary objective of BMV has been to passionately work
towards the creation of a nature friendly environment. BMV is one of the well known manufacturers,
exporters and suppliers of pure essential oils, aroma oils, perfume oils and fragrance oils across
the perfumery industry as a company true to its authenticity and values with every step marked by
creativity and innovation. BMV Fragrances believes in the power of knowledge and commitment for the
satisfaction of our customers across the globe. With a combined experience of more than 87 years and
our continuous and intensive research in the field of [**natural essential oils**][42] and
[**perfumery materials**][43] has enabled us to know our client's needs better for essential oils
and constantly strive to meet their expectations.

This fusion of knowledge, affinity towards nature and creativity has made us one of the largest
producers of essential oils, resin, [**synthetic essential oil**][44], [**reconstitutions**][45] and
[**perfumery bases**][46], perfume oils. We provide [**100% pure essential oils in wholesale**][47],
including Fragrance Oils, Perfume Oils, Aromatherapy Oils, resin manufacturing, along with
Reconstitution Oils and Specialities to different industries. Our top-quality product range has made
us an approved supplier, manufacturer, and trusted brand in wholesaling of essential oils, synthetic
essential oils, fragrance oils and [**resins manufacturer**][48].

We welcome all your requirements of 100% natural, pure & natural essential oils, [**perfume
oils**][49] and [**fragrance oils**][50]. Every single day our team of researchers and innovators
set out to bring a new variety of pure and natural or reconstitutions of oils, synthetic essential
oils, [**resinoids**][51], absolutes and [**perfumery bases**][52] to the shelves to deliver to our
valued customers. We not only make sure that we improve the variety but also maintain the highest
quality of all our products which always live beyond the expectations of our clients. We have a firm
determination to deliver the best products as per our commitments to client satisfaction.

`[Calabria Italy]`

### *A Book About Calabria, Italy*

ONCE THE HUB OF THE MEDITERRANEAN, Calabria now dangles, largely ignored, at the bottom of the
Italian boot, struggling for survival, acceptance and a place in modern Italy and the world.
Little-known even to Italians outside the nefarious activities of its ‘Ndrangheta mafia
organization, Calabria allures with its simplicity and rewards with an underlying complexity, as in
the savoring of an artisanal cheese, appreciating an ancient Greek masterwork or interpreting a
particularly expressive phrase in the local dialect.

Based on the author’s experiences, living, working and traveling throughout the region, as well as
on extensive research, *Calabria: The Other Italy* paints a compelling picture of contemporary
Calabria. The book intertwines observation, personal anecdote, salient historical information and
social commentary into a nonfiction narrative that combines travelogue with an exploration of
everyday life and culture. At times humorous, at others poignant, this fascinating work shares the
joys and challenges of the “other Italy.”

From colorful tales of encounters with the *Calabrese* people to those of a windsurfing saint, from
the unparalleled pair of 2,500-year-old Riace Bronzes to a couple of dancing giants, from ancient
castles and towers to pristine beaches and mountains, from the unique bergamot fruit to an
exceptional culinary tradition, *Calabria: The Other Italy* embraces daily life, culture, history,
the arts, food, society and tourism of this beautiful, southern Italian region. Excursions to Sicily
and Basilicata are also included!

## Natural Food Colors

100% plant-based, vibrant, odor free natural food colors. We gently obtain our natural products from
our own plant sources, where we control the planting, care and harvesting before any processing
takes place.

Our processing typically uses gentle physical processes such as squeezing, rinsing, filtering and
concentrating. Sometimes we take advantage of natural processes within the plant to obtain the raw
materials we use to make our finished products.

## All Natural Sweeteners

A global supplier of sustainable natural sweeteners. FoodRGB^{®} is a natural sweetener
manufacturer, direct sale, and solution provider. We are best in Allulose, Monk Fruit Extract V50,
and Stevia RA98, RA80.

We do natural sweeteners wholesale from coast to coast. We also set up warehouses globally, so we
become sustainable natural sweetener supplier. We are natural sweetener distributors in the USA.
Natural sweetener is complex to use and the quality depends on many factors and varies a lot.

## A Variety of Food and Beverage Applications

We understand the nature of these products and their natural sensitivities associated with natural
food color and natural sweetener systems. As a custom supplier of natural food color ingredients and
sweetening solutions, we continuously refine and optimize our formulations to meet the evolving
performance, stability, and labeling requirements of modern food and beverage applications.

Our research and application teams leverage deep technical expertise in natural food color
stability, pH performance, heat resistance, and processing compatibility to ensure reliable results.
From straightforward formulations to complex manufacturing environments, we develop customized
ingredient solutions designed to perform consistently across diverse food and beverage systems.

## Sertifikalarımız

## 01 Kaynağında Başlayan Kalite

- En iyi ürün, en kaliteli ham maddeyle başlar.

Grup şirketimiz Asuka, dünyanın dört bir yanından etkinliği kanıtlanmış, saf ve farmasötik
kalitedeki hammaddeyi/bileşenleri tedarik eder.

Her gelen ham madde, kendi laboratuvarlarımızda detaylı analizlerden geçerek kalite standartlarımıza
uygunluğu doğrulanır.

Her ham madde, tesisimize ulaştığında; etkin madde oranı, mikrobiyolojik saflık, fiziksel
özellikler, ağır metal ve pestisit kalıntıları ile ilgili kapsamlı testlerden geçirilir. Stabilite
ve raf ömrü ön testleri de uygulanarak uzun vadeli güvenlik ve etkinlik doğrulanır.

-    🧬 Yüksek Saflık | 🌍 Güvenilir Tedarik | 🔬 Kendi Laboratuvarlarımızda Kontrol

## 02 Gelişmiş Teknoloji ile Üretim

- Her kapsülde bilim ve kalite var.

Üretim sürecimiz, bize ait fabrikamızda; farmasötik düzeyde hassasiyet sunan yüksek teknolojili
makinelerle gerçekleştirilir.

🔹 Likit kapsül teknolojisi, lipozomal yapı, CO₂ ekstraksiyonu ile birlikte kromatografi yöntemleri
kullanılarak;

      • Doğal bileşenler saf ve etkili şekilde elde edilir.

      • Ekstraktlardaki aktif madde oranı en üst seviyeye çıkarılır.

      •Aktif bileşenlerin biyoyararlanımı artırılır.

⚙️ GMP uyumlu üretim | 🧠 Biyoyararlanım odaklı formülasyon

## 03 Güvenilir Ürün, Hazır Form

- Tüketicilerimize ulaşan her ürün, bizim imzamızı taşır.

Üretilen her ürün; etkinlik, güvenlik ve stabilite testlerinden geçirilerek şeffaf, kaliteli ve
katkısız içeriklerle kullanıma hazır hale getirilir.

📦 Goodday markalı ürünlerimiz, kapsül, tablet, saşe ve sıvı formda tüketiciyle buluşur.

🔍 Sertifikalı kalite | 🛡 Glutensiz ve güvenli içerik | 🇹🇷 Türkiye’de üretilmiştir

## From Nature to You — Directly and Honestly

At **Herb Bridge**, we’re more than just a supplier — we are the growers, the makers, and the
guardians of two of nature’s most treasured botanicals: **Licorice** and **Damask Rose Buds**.

With deep roots in the fertile lands of Iran, we manage every step — from cultivation to global
shipment — ensuring complete **traceability**, **purity**, and **control over quality**. 

This farm-to-customer model eliminates middlemen, reduces costs, and most importantly, gives our
partners **confidence** in every batch they receive.

As one of the region’s **leading producers**, we are trusted by businesses of all sizes — from
herbal remedy brands to food and pharma manufacturers — to deliver consistently high standards,
tailored packaging, and reliable logistics.

Our **licorice** is sourced from the rich soils of **Yasuj, Fars, and Kerman**, and offered in
multiple forms: roots, powder, and extract. Our **rosebuds**, grown in the world-famous valleys of
**Kashan, Ghamsar, and Niasar**, are prized for their unmatched **fragrance, color, and
cleanliness**.

At Herb Bridge, our mission goes beyond trade. We build **long-term partnerships** based on
transparency, shared values, and a genuine love for what we do. With an expert export team, flexible
order capabilities, and a firm commitment to sustainable practices, we’re ready to support your
success — every step of the way.

## About Horner

##### Horner International is rooted in generations of ancestors who tilled the soil and lived
##### according to the values and traditions of rural North Carolina farming communities. My
##### grandfather was a sharecropper and when my father left the farm for college, there was no
##### money to give him, but he became steward of several acres of farmland, on which he planted,
##### tended, harvested and sold the crops to pay his way through school.  My grandmother tended a
##### garden into her eighties; little did she know that her ways might be described by the
##### buzzwords of our day: artisanal, organic, locavore, hand-crafted.  Proust had his madeleine;
##### for me, the aromas of childhood are just-shucked corn, my mother’s cobbler from freshly-picked
##### blueberries, and the incomparable fresh butter bean, which reaches perfection during perhaps a
##### fortnight in the hot North Carolina summer.   Real food, as close to nature as possible, is in
##### our blood.

##### Horner International’s first product in 1995 was a cocoa extract.   We still manufacture it
##### today, and it has been sold continuously on every continent since those early days.  Over the
##### years we have expanded our production capabilities and are constantly in search of new
##### botanicals and production methods.  Like most of the best in life, much of what we do comes
##### from ancient things, like extraction and distillation, but the devil, as the saying goes, is
##### in the details.  Discovering a new plant or developing a new way to extract its flavor thrills
##### and excites us, and is at the heart of what we do.

##### Horner’s second factory, built in 2007, stands in a vanishingly rural part of Durham, North
##### Carolina, and our neighbors include herds of deer, flocks of wild turkeys and a farmer who
##### sells collard greens from his porch.   Down the road is the renowned Research Triangle Park
##### and world-famous universities like UNC-Chapel Hill and North Carolina State, with whom we have
##### collaborated on research projects for over twenty years. Inside our plant is some of the
##### finest and most advanced equipment in the world to extract and perfect natural flavors.  We
##### are constantly investing in new equipment and many of the largest flavor houses and consumer
##### products companies in the world trust us to manufacture extracts and flavors under their
##### names.  As much as we take a “gearhead” pride in our machines, it is people who make the
##### difference at Horner.  It takes a special person to work at a smaller company, for every day
##### is punctuated by what we optimistically call challenges.  The result is that an exceedingly
##### diverse group of strong minds and strong hands crank out the finest natural extracts in the
##### world. Creativity, dedication and pride go into every pail, drum and tote that heads to
##### customers across the globe.  Are you ready for the Alternative to Artificial? Connect  with us
##### and let us show you how.

Panel 2

## The Ethics of Extracts

##### WORKING WITH ALL-NATURAL GOODS MEANS THAT WE CULTIVATE CLOSE RELATIONSHIPs WITH THE
##### INDIVIDUALS AND FARMS THAT SUPPLY OUR RAW MATERIALS. From the blooming desert of xinjiang to
##### our own farm in Bailey, North Carolina, we have two decades of on-the-ground experience with
##### the farmers and soils that produce our raw materials.  Our business cannot exist without
##### sustainable agriculture, and the bumper stickers sometimes seen on North Carolina pickup
##### trucks say it best, “No  farmers, no food.”

Experts français de l’extraction végétale et de l’assemblage aromatique depuis 1898, nous voyons LES
GOÛTS comme DES PATRIMOINES VIVANTS : naturels, authentiques, historiques et iconiques. 
‍

**Notre vocation est de faire (RE)VIVRE ces goûts francs et sincères, **préserver leurs
savoir-faire, faire parler leurs arômes de fleurs, de plantes ou de fruits en les combinant à
l’infini remettre au goût du jour ces saveurs d’un autre temps, être les garants de leur qualité et
de leur pérennité. 
‍

**Parce que ces goûts exceptionnels font parti de notre identité, chez LBDV nous les défendons parce
qu’ils nous ouvrent tout un nouveau monde de boissons. **

* Form: liquid / viscous paste

The plant extraction production line is the core industrial system for modern natural product
processing. Fundamentally, it is a comprehensive process that uses physical or chemical methods to
efficiently separate and purify active ingredients (such as essential oils, polysaccharides,
polyphenols, and proteins) from plant matrices, converting them into high-value-added products.

**Vacuum Belt Dryer**
 
Vacuum Belt Dryer (BVD) is a low-temperature drying method that involves continuously distributing
raw materials onto a conveyor belt under vacuum conditions. The materials are dried as the belt
moves over heating plates, followed by cooling, embrittlement, and pulverization. Throughout the
entire drying process, the extract remains in a vacuum-sealed environment, and the mild drying
conditions (operating temperature: 30–135°C) help preserve its properties to the greatest extent,
resulting in a high-quality final product.
